selected: Configured dual-homed EVPL connections with primary and backup paths
rationale: Dual-homing remote edge routers to distinct HQ provider interfaces satisfies high-availability SLAs and sub-5ms failover guarantees.
Standardized VLAN numbering ensures uniform broadcast domain mapping across campus switches and prevents conflicting PVIDs.

selected: Configured Native VLAN 99 as untagged and unused on all trunks
rationale: Setting the native VLAN to an unused ID (VLAN 99) and disallowing default VLAN 1 mitigates 802.1Q double-tagging and VLAN hopping security vulnerabilities.

selected: Restricted trunk links to explicitly allowed VLAN list [10,20,30,40]
rationale: Explicit allowed-VLAN pruning confines broadcast/multicast traffic strictly to authorized switches, conserving backplane bandwidth.

selected: No-overlap invariant holds across all allocations.
rationale: Monotone carving guarantees non-intersection; verified with an O(n) boundary assertion.

selected: Selected Multi-Area OSPF architecture with Area 0 backbone
rationale: Multi-site topology (3 sites) requires routing-domain isolation. Hierarchical area design isolates LSA flooding, reduces SPF recalculation frequency, and enforces area boundary summarization.

selected: Configured 1 OSPF area(s) with 4 network statements
rationale: Network statements map exact network-aligned CIDRs and inverse wildcard masks directly from the VLSM plan, ensuring flawless LSDB population.

selected: Configured 4-class DiffServ QoS policy on EVPL provider circuits
rationale: Classifies EF Voice (30% priority queue) and AF31 Transactional data (40% bandwidth queue) to guarantee sub-5ms SLA latency under congestion.

selected: Planned deterministic route failover across 2 circuit pair(s)
rationale: Primary circuits are biased with metric 10 while secondary circuits carry metric 20, guaranteeing hitless failover upon primary link flap.
